title: Retire ML Pipeline for proxy_merged — Target is Deterministic Formula
decision: Retire all ML models (XGBoost, LightGBM, ExtraTrees, two-stage classifier→regressor) for proxy_merged prediction. Report the exact formula instead.

context.finding: proxy_merged is an exact deterministic function of 5 training features

project_already_knew.methodology_doc_says: If exact formula found, skip ML entirely

invalidated_results: SHAP importances (measuring formula contribution, not learned patterns)
Tribal bias ratio (property of formula + data distribution, not model)
valid_results: Formula discovery: proxy_merged = -mean(bldg, 2*area, road, poi)/4 + pct_urban - 1
Formula verified with zero error on 85,396 tracts
pct_urban explains 99.87% of target variance alone
85% of tracts have trivial gaps (formula ≈ pct_urban - 1)
road_gap_clip is most sensitive to perturbation

next_steps: 1. Report formula as the solution for proxy_merged
2. Add leakage guard to all training scripts
3. When real target (coverage_gap_score) is released, test if formula applies
4. If real target uses different formula, rebuild with non-leakage features only
5. Pivot ML effort to predicting GAPS from non-gap features (SVI, CVI, hazards)
